title: Prove sperner_ndim to complete Sperner-to-Brouwer pipeline

problemStatement.formal: \forall f : [0,1] \to [0,1], f \text{ continuous} \implies \exists c \in [0,1], f(c) = c
problemStatement.plain: The 1D Brouwer Fixed Point Theorem: any continuous self-map of [0,1] has a fixed point.
whyMatters: Base case of the Sperner-to-Brouwer pipeline
Demonstrates IVT as the 1D analogue of Sperner's lemma
Contractive maps have unique fixed points attracting all iterates

proven: brouwer_1d: Any continuous f:[0,1]→[0,1] has a fixed point (IVT)
contractive_fixed_point_unique: Lipschitz contractions have at most one fixed point
contractive_iterate_converges: Iterates converge geometrically to the fixed point
pipeline_1d: Entry point for the Sperner-Brouwer pipeline at dimension 1
knownResults.goal: Formalize the 1D Brouwer fixed point theorem and the surrounding convergence theory

currentState.focus: Created SpernerNDimOQ03OQ01.lean with 4 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms.

knowledge.progressSummary: PROVED: Created SpernerNDimOQ03OQ01.lean with 4 theorems (0 sorries, 0 axioms). Main result: brouwer_1d via isPreconnected_Icc.intermediate_value₂. Also proves uniqueness and geometric convergence for contractive maps.
builtItems: brouwer_1d: ∀ f continuous, f maps [0,1]→[0,1] → ∃ c ∈ [0,1], f c = c
contractive_fixed_point_unique: Lipschitz constant < 1 → at most one fixed point
contractive_iterate_converges: iterates converge to fixed point with geometric rate
pipeline_1d: Alias of brouwer_1d as the pipeline entry point
insights: Key Mathlib lemma: isPreconnected_Icc.intermediate_value₂ finds c where f(c)=g(c) given f(a)≤g(a) and g(b)≤f(b)
In 1D, Brouwer is IVT applied to f - id: g(0)=f(0)≥0 and g(1)=f(1)-1≤0
Contractive convergence uses tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one for geometric bound
The n-D case requires homeomorphism Δⁿ ≅ [0,1]ⁿ which needs substantial topology
